text: yeah thats the problem though is i dont know the shaders by any formal name only by the way they look. and more specifically the difference between autumn_leaves and lava plasma already is screaming horrible idea to let it resolve by typing a string.
resolution: Type-to-bind is DELETED per the ruling ('i dont know the shaders by any formal name only by the way they look') — no surface resolves a material from a typed string anymore. Commit a6b2f0d2c: extracted MapTexturePicker's paged live-thumbnail grid into the one shared picker organ (cart/editor/shell/MaterialPickerPopover.tsx: thumbs + variant chips + click-away scrim, rendered at the app root per the overlay law) and rewired MapTexturePicker as a thin adapter over it (identical map-paint UX incl. the default chip). The Rig panel's live row is now a thumbnail of the bound material + a 'pick' verb that opens the picker anchored by the inspector; a pick patches the slot's liveMaterial (keeping scale) and the popover STAYS OPEN so looks can be compared live on the mesh — each pick compiles only that material's ~19KB module (req_3400). Docs + memory updated with the picked-by-look law. Hot-reloads, no rebuild.
